## Description

**MyRolePlay is a roleplaying AddOn for World of Warcraft, created by Etarna (aka Myoukochou) and currently developed by Katorie . It allows you to make a profile about your character that other users of MyRolePlay or other RP addons can read, both in a tooltip preview and in its entirety within the profile viewer. It is intentionally less comprehensive and complex than some alternatives, designed to be friendly to players who prefer only the most widely used core elements of RP addons, providing most of the features a roleplayer would desire.**

_**\*MyRolePlay is currently compatible with retail (War Within), Cataclysm Classic, and all versions of Vanilla as one version!**_

**Features**
* The **description and history fields** are available for long form description of your character's physical appearance and history. They fully support HTML text capabilities, giving you control over **text alignment, colours, font size, etc** . You can even add **icons** and **images** and insert clickable **hyperlinks** .
* Spot other roleplayers at a glance and get a quick overview of their character in the **tooltip** !
* Change your character's **name** and **name colour** , allowing for last names, titles, etc.
* Change your character's roleplay **race** or **class** . These will replace your default race / class in the tooltip.
* Tell others what your character is up to (in-character) using the **currently** field, and give some information on your RP style using the **Out of Character** field.
* The " **At a Glance"** field provides a short preview of certain aspects of your character. Assign up to 5 icons with a small paragraph alongside them to see short bits of information!

...

**Eye colour, height, weight** \- use the **description** field if you would like to write up something detailed.
* Give people a taste of your character’s story, if you wish—add biographical information like their **age, hometown, birthplace** , and maybe even some tidbits of **history** to make people hungry to discover more by interacting with your character and roleplaying with you. Or hide others’ biography, if you prefer to discover that kind of thing through interaction.
* Create **multiple profiles per character** , and automatically switch between them (if you'd like) when changing gear sets.

**Editing your profiles**

Bring up the **character panel** (“C” by default), and select the **MyRolePlay tab** underneath. **Click on a field** to edit it.

* **Use the cogwheel button to manage your profiles, such as adding, renaming or deleting them.**
* **The drop down box allows you to change between profiles.**
_Fields that appear dimmed out are ‘inherited’ from the default profile—click to edit them if you wish._

The **options panel** allows you to customise the appearance and functionality of the addon to suit your needs. You can access it via the cogwheel button on the editor, or by typing /mrp options in the chat box.

**Where can I see other people’s details?**

When you mouseover someone who has MyRolePlay (or another compatible addon), you’ll see some of the extra roleplaying details they added in the tooltip.

Want more information about their character than the tooltip provides, like the full description or history (where applicable)? To open the full profile viewer you may:

* Target them and click on the “MRP” information button that appears by the target frame.
* Set a key combination in Key Bindings (under AddOns).
* Use the slash command: **/mrp show <charactername>** or just **/mrp show** when you have someone targeted.

...

A new feature typically requires both ends to be using a version that supports it, and sometimes players can take a little while to update. Also note that MRP specific features may take some time to be picked up by other RP addons. I do work with the authors of the other two, however. In short, be patient.

* **A part of the MRP UI isn't displaying correctly or at all (or the tooltip appears jumbled)**

This is usually caused by conflicts with other addons. Try disabling other addons and see if the issue persists. The usual culprits are addons that specifically modify the tooltip or completely overhaul the UI.

* **My issue isn't listed here and i'm still having problems**

You can send us a message here on CurseForge or use the "Issues" tab and open a new ticket. We'll try to get back to you as soon as possible.

**\*Please when reporting bugs use the "Issues" page (not comments) and be as detailed as possible. Include error text, other addons in use, etc.
Also ensure you're using the latest version of the addon.\***

excerpts:
World of Warcraft Forums

# WoW Up |Curse | Wago

Guides UI and Macro

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 10:28am 1

Hi — I’d been using CurseForge or Wago depending on where an addon was available, but I recently added WoWUp after an addon pack recommended it as the main way to manage everything. I can see all my addons in WoWUp and update them there, but CurseForge and Wago still show updates available too.

Any recommendations on the simplest way to handle this? Also, is there any reason to keep updating through Wago or CurseForge if I’m already updating everything in WoWUp?

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 16, 2026, 4:11pm 2

Neither versions of wowup track changes of each other, or other addon managers for that matter. Best is to have only 1 of the 2. If you need both because some addon isn’t available, ignore everything except that one addon.

1 Like
[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 4:52pm 3

Updating an addon more than once won’t make a difference to the code that’s in place once you’re done (assuming all sites have the same (latest) version).

1 Like

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 5:53pm 4

Sorry - I’m confused by this - can you explain. Do you mean only have curse or Wago? If i delete Wago, will all the addons move to curse that are available on curse if I sync Curse with my addon folder?

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 6:32pm 5

The Curse updater only lists addons on Curse. The Wago updater does the same for Wago, WoWUp lists addons on Curse, Wago and WoWInterface etc.

If you have WoWUp and one of the other installers you will be promted to update common addons by both updaters.
Deleting the installer won’t “move” the addons, it will just restrict the sites used to find/dowload addons to whatever sites your remaining updater(s) support.

1 Like

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 16, 2026, 6:37pm 6

Easy question - if I have the raider io addon which is supported by both wago and curse, but I downloaded it on wago. If I delete wago, will it move to curse app manager?

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 16, 2026, 6:44pm 7

If the addon is on Curse then the Curse downloader should already list it so it would just download it from Curse.

Addon aurthors decide which sites they want to use for people to download their addon(s) and it is up to the aurthors to keep those sites up-to-date. The (legit) download sites just provide a place for people get the addons that have been uploaded to them.

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.
com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 17, 2026, 7:04am 8

Rezdog:

> Sorry - I’m confused by this - can you explain. Do you mean only have curse or Wago? If i delete Wago, will all the addons move to curse that are available on curse if I sync Curse with my addon folder?
> 
>

The TL;DR is that both WowUp CF and WowUp Wago track addons independently. You only need both versions if there’s an addon on Wago that isn’t on CF, and vice versa.

If all of your addons are available on CF, you don’t need the Wago version at all. If you do need the Wago version for a single addon, you can right click and check the ignore button in the Wago version, so only the CF version will be updating it.

Rezdog:

> Easy question - if I have the raider io addon which is supported by both wago and curse, but I downloaded it on wago. If I delete wago, will it move to curse app manager?
> 
>

Not automatically.
In theory there’s a “re-scan” you can do, but there’s currently a bug in the CF app that will “forget” where the addon is coming from if you press that button (TL;DR is that fingerprinting addons is complicated). You can always reinstall the addon if that happens. You can also just uninstall it in the Wago version and then install it in the CF version.

[Bigrez-2270725](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Bigrez-2270725) (Bigrez) April 17, 2026, 11:20am 9

Very helpful - will I lose all my settings per addon - if I delete them from WAGO and reinstall in the CF?

[Linaori-2918678](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Linaori-2918678) (Linaori) April 17, 2026, 12:03pm 10

Yes, as both are isolated apps

[Fizzlemizz-3415](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Fizzlemizz-3415) (Fizzlemizz) April 17, 2026, 2:41pm 11

The question is a bit vague.
Moving from one downloader to another, you won’t loose the game settings you’ve made to the addon itself (in-game) as these are stored by the game, not the downloader.

[Belechannas-1977035](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Belechannas-1977035) (Belechannas) April 17, 2026, 7:36pm 12

To be safe, before making any changes, just create backup copies of your WTF and Interface folders.
